analysis: The only change in docs/developer/test.md is a documentation addition (head lines ~2115-2131, outside the supplied excerpts) describing unit tests for the Model Requant Upload workflow: input and manifest rules, a secret-free preflight, a job in the prod environment, master-only, R2 key-set checks, a pinned-tool upload and a selftest before any secret. The supplied units (head lines 928-1806) are unchanged context: provider endpoint resumption and logout tests, add-on hold tests, config writers, watchdog, App Attest dispatch, native qualification, cluster and TP checks, and fixture downloaders. No code, config, workflow or secret handling is modified in the supplied evidence, so no control (TB-002/TB-003/TB-007/TB-011/TB-012, T-041 and related) is weakened, and no trust assumption is invalidated. The documentation describes test coverage and states limits (not native model quality, not physical qualification). Remaining integration question: the added doc lines cite scripts/models tests and a requant workflow that are not in the supplied evidence, so I could not verify that the described security properties (prod environment gating, master only, hash-pinned tools, secret ordering) hold in the actual workflow or scripts. That is a separate change and not a regression from this docs diff. No new attack surface is introduced by this file.
